title: Dr. Carvalho's 35 Colares patients, interviewed by Jacques Vallee
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Dr. Carvalho's 35 Colares patients, interviewed by Jacques Vallee, about 1977 at Colares, Pará, Brazil, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: spoke to Dr. Carvalo who saw 35 patients who all had the same sunburns and puncture wounds and the two women that died of a stroke

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that the UFO researcher Jacques Vallee spoke with a Dr. Carvalho in Colares, a town in Pará state in Brazil, around 1977. According to Michels, the doctor had seen 35 patients who all had the same sunburns and puncture wounds, and two women had died of a stroke. Michels cites Vallee's published journals, Forbidden Science, and tells it as part of Brazilian cases he says the country's defence minister confirmed as real.
